description: 燕尾杀：白象走位封锁，黑后对角线将死
explanation_en: The bishop moves to complete the blockade around the white king, allowing the black queen to deliver dovetail mate.

intro.popup: 💡 燕尾杀：注意白王的位置。白象走位后，黑后将从对角线发动燕尾杀。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Dovetail mate: Watch the white king's position. After the white bishop moves, the black queen will attack along the diagonal.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Ba4走位完成最后封锁，Qf1#燕尾杀。白象的位移是创造将杀条件的关键。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Ba4 completes the final blockade, and Qf1# delivers dovetail mate. The bishop's move creates the mating conditions.

moves.popup: 白象走a4，完成封锁——配合其他棋子封死白王的逃格。
moves.popup_en: The bishop moves to a4 to complete the blockade, working with the other pieces to cover the white king's escape squares.

moves.popup: 黑后Qf1#，燕尾杀！王被己方棋子封死，后沿对角线将死。
moves.popup_en: Qf1# is dovetail mate! The king is trapped by its own pieces as the queen delivers mate along the diagonal.
